releases.title: INL’s New Software Funding Targets Browser Access and Easier Licensing
releases.description: Two commercialization projects address different obstacles to using laboratory software. Existing INL records show why a usable application and permission to use it need separate checks.

releases.description: A newly released court report examines who owns, approves and updates the material an operational chatbot could use. Adopted principles keep people accountable.
